grammatica.evidence: Policy-essay English: multi-clause declaratives, parallel openers ('A text editor… A new document… A web form…'), short rebukes ('This is wrong.'); no coinages; public register.

dialectica.evidence: Chain from 'defaults are the strongest choices… no one notices making' through moral weight, anti-zero-defaults, revealed-interest paternalism, 80/20 harm shape, living hypothesis, combo explosion, to crypto-parameter governance—not a mechanical public derivation.

rhetorica.evidence: Chose retirement 30%/90%, newsletter/tax endorsement, triad telemetry/ballots/organs, 10→1000 configs, crypto analogy close; ordered mechanism→ethics→method→incentives over dark-patterns or GDPR leads.

arithmetica.evidence: Atoms beyond stock pointers: defaults strongest because unnoticed; moral weight 'out of proportion'; choice as spendable resource; default as 'living hypothesis'; treat like 'cryptographic parameters'; 'quieter governance failures.'

geometria.evidence: Unheaded linear multi-paragraph essay only; no lists, sections, or apparatus—standard public op-ed/essay page shape.

musica.evidence: Punch lines ('This is wrong.'; 'The incentives are wrong.') alternate with long expansions; tricola of cases; measured multi-clause close on 'quieter governance failures.'

astronomia.evidence: Arc: redefine→refute passive view→two strength sources→moral triad→reject no-defaults→which/for whom→heterogeneity→iterate→interactions→measure→invisible labor→crypto/governance indictment.

notes: Public substrate already carries nudge/retirement and organ-donation default facts; dialectica and arithmetica originality sit in the engineering-governance synthesis, not those stock premises.
